tool_args.rationale: Acquire additional trajectories before fitting the four-parameter coupled ODE. The irregular prefixes must be folded using elapsed time relative to each prefix, not the absolute timestamps.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the four-parameter coupled memory ODE to the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The supplied mechanism guidance specifies at least eight trajectories for parameter identification; five leave genuine ambiguity.
The verified history-conditioned mechanism and irregular-prefix guidance identify the trajectory batch as the relevant probe.
The endpoint-matched history gap and coupled transient lag indicate history dependence that a snapshot model cannot capture.
